title: Make live capture and grounded notes responsive and truthful
summary: Connect the retained native ASR path to the real recorder, remove repeated Codex live submissions, keep local key messages useful, and show only grounded final notes with source evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Live recorder uses the local retained Small ASR endpoint when available and falls back once to browser captions without retry storms.
Recording stop does not wait for an in-flight live Codex request; the final summary is the single grounded Codex pass.
While recording, local Key Messages remain visible; a failed Codex request is not represented as a completed raw-text summary.
Final note items retain exact source evidence quotes and backup validation preserves them.
The transcript and notes UI labels the actual native/fallback path and surfaces source evidence.
npm run check and npm run build pass.
evidence: npm ci, npm run check and npm run build pass
13 runtime/bridge tests pass, including bounded live queue, silence handling, translation disposal and grounded citation validation
real native live synthetic English and Chinese smoke passes: warmup about 4 seconds, 6-second requests about 2.5-3.4 seconds, silence pass
front-end no longer submits the growing full transcript to Codex every 30 seconds; stop cancels live AI and keeps one final grounded pass
Codex evidenceQuote is retained in brief items and validated in backup import
